eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (ICECE) is a pioneering international conference in the fields of electrical, electronic, communication, and computer engineering. It has been regularly organized biennially since 2001 by the Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering (EEE) at Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET).
